title: Oracle Database
description: An Oracle database — on premises, Oracle Cloud (Autonomous Database), Amazon RDS for Oracle — read through its thin client (no Oracle client installed).

fields.name: schema
fields.label: Schema
fields.help: Whose tables to read; the user's own when empty.

setup.title: Where the database is
setup.say:
The address Oracle answers on, as the engine reaches it — a name like db.example.com, or an IP address. Not "localhost", unless the engine runs on that same machine.

If the database lets in only known addresses (a firewall, an allow-list, a cloud security group), let the engine's machine in first.

setup.title: A user that may read
setup.say: The database's service name (FREEPDB1, ORCLPDB1…) and a user that may read — run this as an admin (choose a password):

copy.label: Make a read-only user

setup.title: Which schema
setup.say: Leave it empty to read the user's own, or name the schema whose tables to read.
